segments.text: WHen the comforter is come whom I will ſende vnto you from the father (euen the ſpirite of trueth, whiche procedeth of the father) he ſhall teſtifye of me. And ye ſhall beare witnes alſo, becauſe ye haue been with me from the beginning.

Theſe thinges haue I ſayd vnto you, becauſe ye ſhould not bee offended. They ſhall excommunicate you: yea
the time ſhal come, that whoſoeuer killeth you, wil thinke that he doeth God ſeruice. And ſuche thinges will they do vnto you, becauſe they haue not knowen the father, neither yet me. But theſe thinges haue I told you, that whan the tyme is come, ye maye remembre then that I tolde you. Theſe thinges ſayde I not vnto you at the beginning, becauſe I was preſent with you.
